The complete absence of any legible characters or standard UI elements on a device screen is a strong indicator of AI generation (semantic failure), warranting a higher severity (3.0-3.5). The hinge ambiguity noted by the Router is also a valid structural weakness, though less severe than the screen issue. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask only confirms the object is a single blob, not that its internal components (keys) are physically distinct.
